reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
), numbered AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT user_id, session_no, (epoch(MAX(event_ts)) - epoch(MIN(event_ts))) / 60 AS length_minutes
  FROM numbered
  GROUP BY user_id, session_no
)
SELECT CASE WHEN length_minutes < 10 THEN 'under 10'
    WHEN length_minutes < 30 THEN '10 to 30'
    WHEN length_minutes < 60 THEN '30 to 60'
    ELSE '60 or more' END AS length_band,
  COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM sessions
GROUP BY 1

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts,
    LEAD(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS next_ts
  FROM app_events
), edges AS (
  -- one row per session start or end
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start,
    CASE WHEN next_ts IS NULL OR next_ts - event_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_end
  FROM gaps
), paired AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT s.user_id, s.event_ts AS session_start,
    (SELECT MIN(e.event_ts) FROM edges e WHERE e.user_id = s.user_id AND e.is_end = 1 AND e.event_ts >= s.event_ts) AS session_end
  FROM edges s
  WHERE s.is_start = 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN epoch(session_end) - epoch(session_start) < 600 THEN 'under 10'
    WHEN epoch(session_end) - epoch(session_start) < 1800 THEN '10 to 30'
    WHEN epoch(session_end) - epoch(session_start) < 3600 THEN '30 to 60'
    ELSE '60 or more' END AS length_band,
  COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM paired
GROUP BY 1

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM app_events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS sn FROM f),
ss AS (SELECT user_id, account_id, sn, MIN(event_ts) AS st, MAX(event_ts) AS en, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY user_id, account_id, sn) SELECT CASE WHEN epoch(en - st) < 600 THEN 'under 10' WHEN epoch(en - st) < 1800 THEN '10 to 30' WHEN epoch(en - st) < 3600 THEN '30 to 60' ELSE '60 or more' END AS length_band, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM ss GROUP BY 1
